question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

83, 299, 424, 488, ?
solution:
**Logic :** Cube of decreasing number series is added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71a398bc0b68072d21b3e3385934471761d4af20b15abc1282e2866b7abe19a9.png]
